text.feels_intro: How {name}'s claw wounds feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a set of thin, parallel scratches across {his} cheek, beading blood.
{name}'s face: deep parallel rakes from brow to jaw where great talons swiped across it, flesh parted in strips and bleeding freely. It smells of blood.
{name}'s face: torn open in long, ragged furrows down to the bone, one strip of skin hanging loose, blood streaming over {his} neck. The iron stench of blood is thick around {him}.
body: {name}'s back: thin parallel scratches through the clothing, beading blood.
{name}'s back: long, deep claw rakes across the back, clothing slashed to ribbons and soaked dark with blood. A coppery smell of blood rises from {him}.
{name}'s back: laid open in broad, parallel furrows from shoulder to hip, flesh peeled back in strips over the ribs, blood pouring. {name} reeks of blood.
arm: {name}'s {part}: deep claw rakes across the muscle, the flesh parted in strips, blood running to the fingers.
{name}'s {part}: slashed to the bone in long talon furrows, muscle hanging in strips; the arm is useless.
leg: {name}'s {part}: deep claw rakes down the thigh, trousers slashed and blood running into {his} boot.
{name}'s {part}: slashed to the bone in long talon furrows, flesh hanging in strips; the leg buckles under any weight.

head: {name}'s face stings along the scratches. {name} is startled and wary, eyes darting.
{name}'s face burns and throbs along the deep rakes. {name} is frightened, breathing hard and flinching from any movement.
{name}'s face is blinding, tearing agony. {name} is in shock, gasping or sobbing, barely able to talk.
body: {name}'s back stings along the scratches. {name} is tense and keeps {his} distance.
{name}'s back burns in long lines of fire with every breath. {name} moves stiffly, frightened.
{name}'s back is tearing agony from shoulder to hip. {name} is in shock and close to collapse.
arm: {name}'s {part} burns and throbs and the grip is weak. {name} cradles it.
{name}'s {part} is shrieking agony and will not work. {name} holds it away, in shock.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings with each step. {name} is quick to flinch.
{name}'s {part} burns and throbs along the rakes. {name} limps, frightened.
{name}'s {part} is shrieking agony and will not take weight. {name} falls or needs support.

levels: , the great talons slicing across the skin in a fast swipe. {name} cries out and stumbles back, thin lines of blood welling.
, the claws ripping across wounds already open. Flesh parts in long strips and {name} screams as blood runs freely.
, and the talons tear deep across the torn flesh, a brutal backhand swipe. {name} is flung off balance, blood spraying, the pain sickening.
, and it is too much. The claws carve through {name} in long, ragged furrows; {name} reels, ashen, and crumples in a spreading pool of blood.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.

start_unhurt.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. With no wounds to mend, it simply washes over {obj}, warm and soothing.
start_unhurt.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. With no wounds to mend, it simply feels warm and soothing.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s injuries is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} injuries, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.

head: the great claws swipe across {name}'s face and throat, carving deep parallel furrows through skin, muscle and windpipe; blood sprays in a hot fan and {name} drops, the head half torn from the neck.
a monstrous talon rakes across {name}'s skull and peels the scalp and face away in strips; {name} reels blind, screaming, and falls dead in the thick reek of blood.
body: the claws rake across {name}'s belly and open it in long, parallel slashes; the guts spill out in steaming loops and {name} sinks to the ground clutching at them, screaming, until the screams fade.
a brutal swipe of great talons carves {name}'s chest open from shoulder to hip, the ribs laid bare and splintered; {name} is flung aside like a doll and lands dead in a red spray.
arm: the claws tear through {name}'s {part} at the shoulder and rip it half away, leaving it hanging by strips of muscle as blood gushes; {name} screams and falls, bleeding out in seconds.
the talons slash {name}'s {part} to the bone and carry on across the chest; {name} spins with the blow and crashes down dead in a pool of blood.
leg: the claws carve {name}'s {part} open from hip to knee, severing the great vessel; blood fountains out and {name} goes down screaming, bleeding out where {name} falls.
a swipe of great talons shears through {name}'s {part} and drops {name} to the ground; a second rake tears across the back and {name} dies in the dirt, flesh hanging in strips.

soil: As {name}'s body goes slack, the stink of {name}'s shit and piss mixes with the blood.
In death {name}'s bowels and bladder let go, and the stench of shit and piss joins the smell of blood.
